messages.text:
I see there are 2 Thor P2. Is it possible to amend it to 1. Thank you.

Andrew T.
Handed to the team · Quantity reduction means money back to the customer, which needs Georges' or Abe

Hi Andrew,

Thanks for catching that quickly. I've found order Shop····, placed yesterday, with two Hammer Thor P2 units on it and nothing shipped yet.

I've put a hold on the order straight away so the warehouse does not pack both units while this is being sorted. Dropping the quantity to one means money going back to you, and that has to be approved by a supervisor rather than by me, so I've put the request in front of the team with the order details. They pick it up today from 10am ET and will come back to you by email in this same thread to confirm.

For reference, the Thor P2 on your order ships November 30. If you'd rather keep both after all, just tell me and I'll lift the hold.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support

I understand the Thor P3 won't ship until November but if the order can be amended to one I will be most grateful and I may just get a P3 on the future if and when you stock it

Here's hoping that your supervisor says yes to the amendment and refund

Andrew T.

Hi Andrew,

Noted, and thank you for the patience. Your request to bring the Thor P2 down to one unit is with the team now, and the order stays on hold on both sides in the meantime, so nothing gets packed or shipped while they look at it. They will reply here in this thread with the outcome.

On a future unit, I cannot promise anything we do not yet stock, but if a newer Thor lands in our range it will show up on the product page with its own ship date, so it is worth a look before you order again.

Nothing else is needed from you for now.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support

I will wait for the outcome then.

Andrew T.

Hi Andrew,

That's fine, nothing more is needed from your side. The order stays on hold while the team reviews the amendment, and they will write to you here with the outcome.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support

Thank you I will check my bank next week.

Andrew T.

Hi Andrew,

That sounds good. Everything is settled on our side: your order now shows one Hammer Thor P2, the refund has gone back to your original payment method, and the hold is off so your remaining unit is queued as normal for its November 30 ship date. You will get the tracking by email as soon as it goes out.

It was a pleasure helping you with this one. If you were happy with how it went, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You are also very welcome in our Discord, where JD and the community talk firmware, tuning and new products: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support
